credit_desc: This person's store credit quota. Charges and payments happen ONLY on the POS with a PIN; from here you manage the quota and the history.
email_missing: The person has no email: add one to activate the quota.
pin_locked: PIN locked after failed attempts. Use Resend PIN to reset it.
pin_send_failed: The PIN was saved but could not be emailed: {{error}} Configure email and use Resend PIN.
pos_only: Charges and payments: POS terminals only.
no_person: This record has no linked person (no quota possible).
pending_desc: Charges authorized on the POS whose sale has not synced in a batch yet. If they expire, the quota is released automatically.
